capacity_gross_kwh.notes: CarExpert (S spec): 111.9 kWh gross; Wikipedia 112 total. All Eletre trims use the same 112 kWh pack (Canada trims differ in motors and range only, per Auto123).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: CarExpert: 109 kWh usable. CONFLICT: Wikipedia lists 107 usable / 112 total.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Auto123 (Canada): "sits on an 800-volt electric architecture"; Wikipedia 800 V; CarExpert lists a 708 V nominal pack.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Lotus software notes: Hyper OS 1.5.1u made battery pre-conditioning use navigation information, Hyper OS 2.2.0 added a manual battery-preheating switch (page has no dates; Canadian 2026 cars are assumed to run 2.2.0 or later). Canadian owner manual not opened.

dc_max_kw.notes: Lotus Canada charging page: 350 kW DC adds 400 km in about 20 minutes. Wikipedia infobox also says 430 kW; CarExpert 350 kW. Peak figure varies by source.

ac_max_kw.notes: Lotus Canada charging page: "22 kW AC charger built-in".

published_10_80_min.notes: CarExpert: 10-80% about 20 minutes at 350 kW (Lotus: 400 km in about 20 min).
